what: Descartes makes logistics software: customs filings, route planning, carrier rate shopping and the network that connects shippers, carriers and brokers to exchange shipment data.
customers: Freight forwarders, carriers, retailers and manufacturers managing international shipments.
money: subscriptions and transaction fees on the logistics network
moat: A network where each new participant makes the others more valuable, plus customs filing software that must be certified with each country's authorities.
risks: Transaction revenue falls when global trade volumes fall
Trade policy changes can disrupt the customs filing volumes it earns on
opportunities: A 22.5% net margin and $299M of free cash flow on $775M of revenue
Revenue grew from $349M to $729M in five years, mostly recurring
$357M of cash against $8M of debt, and analysts see about 14% upside
watch: Services revenue growth and the pace of acquisitions.
